name: MMBench-CN
intro: MMBench-CN 是 MMBench 的中文子集/分项，报告中用于观察多模态模型中文视觉问答表现。
build_method: MMBench中文版本, 人工/翻译验证, 混合构建
eval_feature: 中文视觉问答, CircularEval, 选项抽取
build_method_en: MMBench Chinese version, Human/translation verification, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Chinese Visual QA, CircularEval, Choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-CN is the Chinese subset or breakdown of MMBench used in reports to inspect multimodal Chinese visual-QA performance.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Start from the official MMBench image multiple-choice question pool"] --> B["Use the verified Chinese version released by OpenCompass"]
    B --> C["Keep Chinese dev and test splits aligned with the original benchmark structure"]
    C --> D["Build prompts from an image, question, hint, and answer options"]
    D --> E["Apply CircularEval by rotating options across multiple passes"]
    E --> F["Extract model choices with rule matching and ChatGPT when needed"]
    F --> G["Submit test predictions to the official MMBench evaluation service"]
    G --> H["Report Chinese visual-question-answering accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从官方MMBench图像多选题池出发"] --> B["使用OpenCompass发布的经验证中文版本"]
    B --> C["保持中文开发集和测试集与原始基准结构对齐"]
    C --> D["由图像、问题、提示和候选项构建评测提示"]
    D --> E["通过选项轮换多次推理执行CircularEval"]
    E --> F["用规则匹配并在必要时用ChatGPT抽取模型选项"]
    F --> G["将测试预测提交到官方MMBench评测服务"]
    G --> H["报告中文视觉问答准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MMBench paper arXiv:2307.06281 and the OpenCompass MMBench repository. MMBench-CN is treated as the verified Chinese version/subset of MMBench rather than a separate paper. The repo lists CN dev/test splits and states that the benchmark uses images, multiple-choice questions, a verified Chinese release, CircularEval option rotation, rule-based plus ChatGPT choice extraction, and official submission for test accuracy.
